title_as_printed: Chemically determined values of oxygen solubility in ml/l. (from an atmosphere of 20.94 % O2 and 100 % relative humidity) and corresponding smooth curve values and differences, together with interpolated values from smoothed data of CARPENTER (1966) and GREEN and CARRITT (1967).
pressure_note: equilibration with air (20.94 % O2, 100 % relative humidity) at atmospheric pressure; barometric pressure measured but total pressure not given in this paper (760 mm in the Part I definition)

value.reference_state: STP gas volume per litre of water at T, air saturated with water vapour; see notes

value3.what: interpolated from Green and Carritt's tables

composition.other_species: natural sea water of the stated salinity (chlorinity = salinity/1.80655); sea-water matrix, not a six-ion composition

extra_unmapped: Smoothed curve value (authors' smoothed fit; model-generated)
conversion_needs: ml/l to mole fraction or molality needs STP molar volume, water density and O2 partial pressure (20.94 % of (760 mm - water vapour pressure))
salinity per mil to molality needs composition assumption
notes: Chemical (Winkler) determinations, each the average of triplicate measurements (average SD 0.008 ml/l); includes the correction of 0.011 ml/l for O2 dissolved in Winkler reagents. Temperature printed once per block beside the middle row; filled down. Two rows (9.95 C, 40.201 permil S; 29.80 C, 39.120 permil S) have no smoothed value or difference printed (left empty). Block sizes 5,5,5,6,6,5,5,5,6,5.
volume_basis_evidence: Murray and Riley 1969 (O2): solubility in ml/l; the paper does not say whether the litre is of seawater or of water.
